caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular, box-like metal objects, both positioned horizontally. The upper object is rendered in detail and shaded in tones of gray and metallic, with one visible long side containing six circular holes and a small, round protruding knob near the middle. Partitions and a sliding mechanism are present inside the open-topped rectangular structure, with vertical end-pieces rising at both ends. The lower object is illustrated as a line drawing in red-brown color without shading; it matches the upper structure in overall shape and features, showing the same circular holes, a central knob or latch element, and internal partitions. The background is a plain, light beige without any other objects, and the artist’s name, "ALFRED C. KOEHN," is written in small letters to the left of the lower object.
title: Printer's Measure
